remarks: Welcome to The Madrid at The Five Greenwich. Presented by Corner North Ventures & designed by Fofie & Mia's, this designer-furnished luxury townhome blends modern European-inspired design with elevated downtown Greenwich living. Thoughtfully curated interiors feature soaring ceilings, statement lighting, sculptural furnishings, layered textures, & a custom kitchen with oversized island seating. The primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath & custom closets, while a second bedroom provides flexible use. Two parking spaces, in-unit laundry, & turnkey convenience. Moments from Greenwich Ave, Metro-North, parks, cafes, fine dining, & shopping, The Madrid delivers a rare luxury rental experience in the heart of downtown Greenwich. Five Curated Homes. One Greenwich Lifestyle.
